sum: Barfresh Food Group, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes ready-to-drink and ready-to-blend frozen beverages in the United States. It offers smoothies, shakes, and frappes. The company provides ready-to-drink smoothies under the Twist & Go brand name; a no sugar added version of the bulk format products under the Easy Pour brand name; juice concentrates under the WHIRLZ brand name; and ready-to-eat juice pop under the Pop & Go brand name. It distributes its products primarily through distributors to school districts and institutional customers. Barfresh Food Group, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is based in Los Angeles, California.
ceo: Mr. Riccardo  Delle Coste (Founder, President, CEO, Interim CFO & Chairman)
